female.sp: Preserve the MRX-010 Psycho Gundam Mk-II's unmistakable gigantic, blocky transformable-mobile-fortress identity while translating it into one clearly adult, cute-faced yet imposing glamorous woman. Use the canonical dark indigo-black and royal-purple armor with vivid magenta-red panels, yellow vent blocks and bright pink sensor accents. Keep the huge squared external shoulder armor, tall slab-like chest, thick forearm armor, massive layered hip plates, bulky lower-leg armor and broad armored feet. Preserve the three prominent diffuse mega-beam-cannon ports across the torso and the distributed circular mega-beam-gun ports in their recognizable positions on both shoulders, hips, front skirt and lower legs. Integrate the head-mounted twin-barrel mega beam gun and Gundam crest as an external mechanical crown above the hair without covering the human face. Keep all ten human fingertips capped by small beam-gun emitter hardware, not extra fingers. Mount one enormous rectangular folding shield on the left forearm, fully visible and mechanically attached; retain the forearm psycommu beam-sword housings in a stowed, unlit state. Show the upright mobile-suit form only, not the mobile-fortress transformation. Exactly two biological human arms and two human legs; no extra limbs, duplicated hands, floating armor, robot face or helmet hiding the face. Keep both shoulder armors present and symmetrical in height. The open armor design may reveal tasteful areas of skin around the upper torso, waist, hips and thighs while remaining secure and fully opaque. Full-body vertical composition with the entire crest, shoulders, shield, hands, leg armor and feet inside frame. Keep the woman at the largest practical scale with only minimal headroom and floor space; do not add generous side margins or pull the camera back farther than necessary. Soft neutral studio background, no battlefield, no pilot resemblance, no text, no logo, no watermark.
